setup.js: (()=>{window.__avisos=[];const re=/N[ãa]o foi poss[ií]vel|Erro ao|Tente novamente|indispon[ií]vel|Algo deu errado|Falha ao/i;const chk=(t)=>{t=(t||'').trim();const m=t&&t.match(new RegExp('[^]{0,40}('+re.source+')[^]{0,40}','i'));if(m&&window.__avisos.length<10)window.__avisos.push(m[0].replace(/[\n\r\t ]+/g,' '))};new MutationObserver(ms=>{for(const m of ms){m.addedNodes.forEach(n=>chk(n.textContent));if(m.type==='characterData')chk(m.target.textContent)}}).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});chk(document.body.innerText);setInterval(()=>{const f=document.querySelector('section[aria-label^="Lembrete da trilha"]');if(f&&window.__avisos.length<10&&!window.__avisos.includes('TRILHA ECOFLIX'))window.__avisos.push('TRILHA ECOFLIX')},300);return 1})()

steps.js: (async()=>{const esp=["37,5"];let out='';for(let i=0;i<12;i++){const v=[...document.querySelectorAll("main"+' input, '+"main"+' textarea')].map(e=>e.value).join(' | ');const falta=esp.filter(e=>!v.includes(e));if(!falta.length)return 'OK: '+esp.join(' | ');out='DIFERENTE: faltou '+JSON.stringify(falta)+' em: '+v.slice(0,260);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));}return out})()

steps.js: (async()=>{const rolagem=(el)=>{let c=el&&el.parentElement;while(c&&c!==document.body){const s=getComputedStyle(c);if(/(auto|scroll)/.test(s.overflowY)&&c.scrollHeight>c.clientHeight+4)return c;c=c.parentElement;}const se=document.scrollingElement;return se&&se.scrollHeight>se.clientHeight+4?se:null};const el=[...document.querySelectorAll("main *")].filter(e=>e.textContent.trim().startsWith("Outros resultados da produ\u00e7\u00e3o")).sort((a,b)=>a.textContent.length-b.textContent.length)[0];if(!el)return 'SEM ALVO';const c=rolagem(el);if(!c)return 'SEM ROLAGEM';const dy=Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top-300);if(Math.abs(dy)<3)return 'ok';const y0=c.scrollTop,t0=performance.now();await new Promise(res=>{const f=t=>{const p=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/900),e=p<.5?2*p*p:1-Math.pow(-2*p+2,2)/2;c.scrollTo({top:y0+dy*e,behavior:'instant'});p<1?requestAnimationFrame(f):res()};requestAnimationFrame(f)});return Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top)})()
